items.title: 18.6 Gene linkage and crossing over (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu overview of gene linkage and crossing over (PDF 100-103).

blocks.text: Mendel ko chromosomes ka ilm nahi tha. Jab us ka kaam dobara daryaft hua to mahireen-e-hayatiyat ne us ke 'factors' ko chromosomes se joda, aur is se us ke qawaneen aur woh soorten bhi samajh aayin jahan yeh qawaneen nahi chalte.

items: Gene linkage: aik hi chromosome ke genes ikatthe virasat mein jate hain, jo independent assortment ke khilaf hai.
Crossing over: meiosis I mein homologous chromosomes ke darmiyan hisson ka tabadla, jo linked genes ko juda kar ke nasl (progeny) badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa amal do linked genes ko juda kar sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Meiosis I ke dauran homologous chromosomes ke darmiyan crossing over.

items: Linkage aik chromosome ke genes ko ikattha rakhti; crossing over unhein naye milap mein lata hai.
